messages.author: 6f9739ea511c7a89
messages.subject: runUrl odd behavior
parts:
Hi all,

I'm using runurl on a zip file off my company's intranet and keep getting the error "zip file '/var/folders.../file.zip" cannot be opened.  When I run the runurl example in the tutorial I see it downloads the zip file to that directory and the app runs fine.  So I watched the contents of that directory as I did runUrl() on my file, and the zip file does download but immediately disappears.

To make sure there was nothing wrong with my zip file I also downloaded the sample zip off github and uploaded it to my server, and the same thing happens when I runUrl it. File downloads to that /var/ directory but immediately disappears and I get the "zip cannot be opened" error.

Any thoughts on what may be causing this?

Thanks,
John

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: runUrl odd behavior
parts:
One thing to try is to download the zip file using the same code that runUrl uses, and then inspect the zip file:
  url <- "http://something.com/yourfile.zip"
  shiny:::download(url, "file.zip", mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)

If you still have problems, it would be helpful if you include your sessionInfo().

-Winston

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: runUrl odd behavior
parts:
Hm, does the zip file have a subdirectory containing the app? That's one of the assumptions that runUrl makes. For example, the zip file should contain the following:
  myapp/server.r
  myapp/ui.r

If they're contained in the top level, I think it won't work:
  server.r
  ui.r

If that still doesn't fix it, it would be helpful if could send me an email directly and let me see the actual file, if that's possible.

-Winston
